page.overview:
Who is Rapid-Fire?

{| class="wikitable" style="border-collapse:collapse;"

!style="border:1px solid black" colspan=2|Generation 1

The only version of Rapid-Fire ever released was in the 1991 series of A Real American Hero toys, carded with a VHS copy of "Revenge of the Pharaohs." ----

Appearance: brown hair; black sleeveless shirt under neon green armor vest; orange armbands and blue pants; silver belt; black boots; orange kneepads. Repaint of Super Trooper.
